svg.title: Rembrandt Reyes
svg.desc: Lorem LLC, Phoenix, Arizona. Most software is disposable. Ours is not. Sunset over the red rocks of Sedona, with saguaro, ocotillo and cholla in the foreground and a hawk circling overhead.
svg.text: Most software is disposable. Ours is not.
